question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
WITH player_match_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bbb.match_id,
        bbb.striker AS player_id,
        bs.runs_scored AS rs,
        pm.team_id
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball bbb 
        ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id 
        AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id 
        AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id 
        AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
    JOIN player_match pm 
        ON bbb.match_id = pm.match_id 
        AND bbb.striker = pm.player_id
),
player_match_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        player_id,
        team_id,
        SUM(rs) AS total_runs
    FROM player_match_runs
    GROUP BY match_id, player_id, team_id
    HAVING SUM(rs) >= 100
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_match_totals pmt
JOIN match m ON pmt.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pmt.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE pmt.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name;
